COD.rationale: Content coordinates, an explicit origin/organization entry, and a separate origin/status entry are all present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition linked to a content's organization/access is stated.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit coordinate sets identify represented content and attributes (red/blue) at named referents/times.

D.rationale: Origins/status fields are presented separately from coordinate lists, distinguishing content identity from its status/organization.

O.rationale: Entries describe how contents are organized/presented via origin metadata and candidate structures across current and candidate representations.
